title: Positive component degrees characterize ampleness on a proper curve
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be a proper scheme [def-pc-scheme] over $k$ with topological dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] at most $1$. Let $\mathcal M$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. For each one-dimensional irreducible component $C$ of the reduced scheme $X_{\mathrm{red}}$, let $\widetilde C\to C$ be its normalization [def-sc-normalization]. Then $\mathcal M$ is ample on $X$ in the absolute sense of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] if and only if the degree [def-pc-degree-line-bundle] of the pullback of $\mathcal M$ to every $\widetilde C$ is positive. Zero-dimensional components impose no condition.
